name: AccountDimension
label: account
description: Account dimension, conformed across finance from 1 source. One row per GL account number (ob:accountNumber): General ledger account. Attributes: cost center.

name: AgentDimension
label: agent
description: Agent dimension, conformed across insurance from 2 sources. One row per agent identifier (ob:agentId): Business key of the selling agent. Attributes: agency name, agent email address, agent name, sales region.

name: BranchDimension
label: branch
description: Branch dimension, conformed across finance from 1 source. One row per branch identifier (ob:branchId): Business key of a bank branch. Attributes: branch name, branch manager name.

name: CurrencyDimension
label: currency
description: Currency dimension, conformed across finance from 2 sources. One row per currency code (ob:currencyCode): ISO 4217 currency code.

name: CustomerDimension
label: customer
description: Customer dimension, conformed across finance, insurance, retail from 5 sources. One row per customer identifier (ob:customerId): Identifies the person or business that buys or holds a product. Attributes: customer email address, customer name.

name: DateDimension
label: date
description: Date dimension, conformed across finance, healthcare, insurance, retail from 11 sources. Generated from the values the sources carry. Attributes: admission date, agent hire date, authorization timestamp, branch open date, claim reported timestamp, discharge date, fill date, date of loss, order placed timestamp, policy effective date, policy expiration date, posting date, product launch date, sale timestamp.

name: FacilityDimension
label: facility
description: Facility dimension, conformed across healthcare from 1 source. One row per facility code (ob:facilityCode): Business key of the care facility.

name: LocationDimension
label: location
description: Location dimension, conformed across finance, healthcare, insurance, retail from 7 sources. Generated from the values the sources carry. Attributes: city, country code, postal code, state code.

name: MerchantDimension
label: merchant
description: Merchant dimension, conformed across finance from 1 source. One row per merchant name (ob:merchantName): Doing-business-as name of the merchant. Attributes: merchant category code.

name: PatientDimension
label: patient
description: Patient dimension, conformed across healthcare from 2 sources. One row per patient medical record number (ob:patientMrn): Medical record number of the patient. Attributes: patient date of birth, patient sex.

name: PolicyDimension
label: policy
description: Policy dimension, conformed across insurance from 2 sources. One row per policy number (ob:policyNumber): Business key of an insurance policy. Attributes: line of business.

name: ProductDimension
label: product
description: Product dimension, conformed across retail from 2 sources. One row per product SKU (ob:productSku): Stock keeping unit of a product. Attributes: brand name, list price, product category, product name.

name: ProviderDimension
label: provider
description: Provider dimension, conformed across healthcare from 3 sources. One row per provider NPI (ob:providerNpi): National Provider Identifier of a clinician. Attributes: accepting new patients, provider name, provider specialty.

name: StoreDimension
label: store
description: Store dimension, conformed across retail from 1 source. One row per store identifier (ob:storeId): Business key of a store.
